notes: THE HIGH ANCHOR. This file is staged only into the verifier image and is never on the agent surface. It is a BAR, not a claim to be the optimum of this space: it is the best policy an authoring search over this harness found, and a submission that reaches or beats it scores 1.0. What separates it from the shipped default is that the two regularisers the default inherited from convention -- a uniform weight decay and a tenth of label smoothing -- both cost real nats at a budget where the model is nowhere near fitting the corpus, while the one control the default left at its transcribed upstream value, the logit softcap, was worth moving.
